trigger.error: versioned file missing from checksum manifest: postgresql/migration/flyway/mbwDB/V63__cpf_vendor_baseline.sql

rootCause: The lifecycle bundle builder backfills a hard-coded old V63 baseline whenever that filename is absent, even when the logical pack already has later published V133 history. This creates unregistered historical migration/rollback garbage and cannot be corrected by appending a lower version checksum.
repairDirection: Allow V63/R63 bootstrap only for a truly empty, unpublished logical migration pack; never backfill them into an existing pack. Delete the exact four untracked generated files immediately and prove repeat generation does not recreate them.
